name: data-enrichment
title: Fill a company profile until every field is found

comparison.purpose: Searches a sample index for a company's founding year, headquarters, CEO and headcount, extracts them into a fixed record, and has a reviewer check the result. A choice state, not the model, decides whether the record is complete, and both the gap loop and the reviewer loop spend one MAX_LOOPS budget that ends in `failed` with the partial record, where LangGraph's max_loops returns whatever it last had.

starters.label: Partially covered — a second, targeted search fills the gap
Fully covered — complete after one search pass
Headcount missing everywhere — exhausts the search budget → failed
